sn45.7:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || la || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn45.7:2.1: Rāgavinayo dosavinayo mohavinayo ti bhante vuccati ||
sn45.7:2.2: kissa nu kho etam bhante adhivacanaṃ
sn45.7:3.1: Evam vutte so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn45.7:3.3: Katanaṃ nu kho bhante amataṃ || katamo amatagāmimaggo ti || ||
sn45.7:3.4: Yo kho bhikkhu rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo ||
sn45.7:3.6: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo amatagāmimaggo || seyyathīdaṃ ||
